text: 1352 changes free-busy parsing to use fbprop.getParameter("FBTYPE") || "BUSY", which remains accepted source. The parser still handles date/date and date/duration intervals, with UNKNOWN outside the reported range. The inspected current fixture has explicit FREE and BUSY parameters, so it does not establish a missing-FBTYPE regression test. The code comment cites an RFC default; the external RFC and bug discussion were not read in this blocked-browser pass. This is static source and test-code inspection. title: CalDAV free-busy parsing defaults an omitted FBTYPE to BUSY
